I've written the test plan, `docs/packages/rllab/tests.md`, as a Draft, plus 33 fixture folders under `tests/fixtures/rllab/`. Lint is clean and every gap check is empty: all 12 pipelines have a smoke test and at least one golden case. Nothing in this round is committed yet. The expected outputs below are the oracle the build has to match, so please check the values themselves.

**Strategy:** every pipeline gets a smoke test, `rllab <cmd> --smoke`: 2,000 steps, seeds 1–2, snake unless the pipeline needs another world. Step unit tests and boundary tests are listed per owner module. Model evaluation cases are TC-24, TC-25 and TC-26 under PL-06.

**PL-01, method check**

| Case | Source | Expected | Tolerance and why |
|---|---|---|---|
| TC-01 DQN corridor | Closed form: Q(s, left) = 0.8·0.9^s, Q(s, right) = 0.9^(5−s); seeds 0–4 | Best actions [L, L, R, R, R, R]; agreement ≥ 0.95, passed on every seed | Exact; 0.95 is TRAIN-06's bar |
| TC-02 PPO target | Closed form: best push = −sign(x) at x ∈ {−1, −0.6, −0.2, 0.2, 0.6, 1} | [1, 1, 1, −1, −1, −1]; passed on every seed | 0.1 per dimension, the contract's margin |
| TC-03 check-world answers | The same closed forms | The worlds report exactly those answers | Exact |

**PL-02, training run**

| Case | Source | Expected | Tolerance and why |
|---|---|---|---|
| TC-04 determinism | Snake, budget 2,000, seed 1, run twice | Logs byte-identical, checkpoints equal | Exact, TRAIN-02 |
| TC-05 schedule | TRAIN-01/03/04 | 2,000 steps; checkpoints at steps 0, 200, … 2,000 (**11, see question 1**); 21 evaluations at 0, 100, … 2,000, each over 20 seeds 1,000,000–1,000,019; all LOG-01 fields | Exact |
| TC-06 snake rules | SNAKE-02/05 examples; seeds 0–19 | Starts 3 long; facing up, left → (−1, 0), right → (1, 0), straight → (0, −1); score = food eaten = length − 3; 12 food → 12; ends exactly on wall, body or 100 steps hungry | Exact |
| TC-07 fish score | FISH-04 | Score = hits ÷ 4; 6 hits → **1.5**; lower is better | 1e-12 |
| TC-08 fish physics | FISH-01–03, PREY-02 | Ball speed constant, bounces flip it; fish speed rises and never passes its top, which is below the ball's; respawn ≥ ¼ width from the ball; predator top speed = 1.2 × prey's | 1e-9 relative |
| TC-09 prey score | PREY-05 | Starts 6 / 2 / 10; prey score = pellets ÷ 6 starting prey; 18 pellets, 3 caught → **prey 3, predator 3** | 1e-12 |
| TC-10 bad action | Edge case | Snake action 3 → `ActionError("snake", 3)`; fish (1.5, 0) → `ActionError("fish-0", [1.5, 0])`; state unchanged | Exact |
| TC-11 duplicate name | Edge case | `RunExistsError` on `runs/snake/default/dup`; first run untouched | Exact |
| TC-12 seeds and observation shape | WORLD-01/03, FISH-07, PREY-06 | `reset(42)` twice gives equal steps; observation length fixed; outside the sight radius, seen flag 0 and zeros | Exact |

**PL-06, final evaluation** (TC-16–18, TC-24–26 are designed with `null-hypothesis-testing`)

| Case | Source | Expected | Tolerance and why |
|---|---|---|---|
| TC-16 planted better | Generated scores: learned 12, random 1, rule 8, sd 3, seed 11 | Both nulls rejected | α 0.05 after Holm |
| TC-17 pure noise | 20 generated seeds, 12–31 | At most 1 of the 20 rejects | Family-wise α 0.05 |
| TC-18 lower is better | Learned 0.5, random 2.0, rule 1.2 | Tested as lower: both rejected; tested as higher: both kept | α 0.05 after Holm |
| TC-19 Holm correction | Holm (1979) | (0.01, 0.04) → **(0.02, 0.04)**, both rejected; (0.03, 0.04) → **(0.06, 0.06)**, both kept | 1e-12 |
| TC-20 one failing run | EVAL-05; run means 14, 13, 15, 12, 9, rule 10 | Not beating; failing run **s5**; mean 12.6, range (9, 15) | Exact |
| TC-21 episode count | EVAL-03 | **700** episodes = 500 learned + 100 random + 100 rule, all on seeds 2,000,000–2,000,099 | Exact |
| TC-22 three runs | Edge case | No test; 2 more runs needed | Exact |
| TC-23 predator-prey | PREY-08 and your collapse rule | Two summaries; each team plays rule-based opponents; predator collapse flagged at step **1,600**, prey none | Exact |
| TC-24–26 model evaluations | SNAKE-08, FISH-10, PREY-08 | Every world, variant and team beats both baselines; snake runs ≤ 60 min, batch ≤ 90 min, final evaluation ≤ 10 min | α 0.05 after Holm |

**Other pipelines**

| Case | Pipeline | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| TC-13 | PL-03 | 2 runs in parallel, byte-identical to the same runs done singly |
| TC-14 | PL-04 | A hand-built run at 35% reads step 700 of 2,000, latest evaluation at 700, status `running` |
| TC-15 | PL-05 | Runs differing only in budget → `MixedRunsError` naming `budget`; with 2 runs the title says "2 runs" and notes the band |
| TC-27 | PL-07 | Rule snake, seed 7: pause, step to 30, forward to 31, back twice → `last_step` **(29,)** |
| TC-28 | PL-07 | Rule vs random side by side start on the same frame; the shorter holds its last frame; tracing again gives equal frames |
| TC-29 | PL-08 | H.264 MP4 at 30 fps with one frame per trace frame, made offline |
| TC-30 | PL-09 | Higher is better: 18/20 pass, 15/20 investigate-low, 16/20 pass (bound included), 31/20 investigate-high. Lower is better: 1.2 pass, 1.25 pass (bound included), 1.4 investigate-low, 0.6 investigate-high |
| TC-31 | PL-10 | `# Snake` followed by `## How the method works`, `## Why it works here`, `## Where it struggles`; a second call raises `FileExistsError` |
| TC-32 | PL-11 | The complete write-up passes. The broken one has `Why it works here` empty and `reports/snake/missing.mp4` broken |
| TC-33 | PL-12 | One grid per team, one row and column per checkpoint (**11, see question 1**); each diagonal cell equals the in-training evaluation at that checkpoint, exactly |

**ASSUMPTIONS**
- The seeds, sizes and generator names above are my choices.
- Fish agents are named `fish-0`, `fish-1`, …
- Screen y grows downward, so "up" is (0, −1).
- The three write-up headings are my wording of NOTES-01's three parts.
- Broken links are reported relative to the project root.
- TC-20's run means are my transcription of the spec's "4 beat, 1 doesn't".
- TC-27 assumes the rule snake on seed 7 lasts at least 32 steps.

**Open questions**
1. **Checkpoint count.** TRAIN-03 says 12 checkpoints, but its own example ("0%, 10%, … 100%") lists 11, and PREY-09's 12 × 12 grid uses the same count. I routed this to the spec, defaulting to 11 checkpoints and an 11 × 11 grid. TC-05 and TC-33 follow that default.
2. **DQN check world.** TC-01 gives the corridor two exits, so the best action changes partway along. That way a learner biased toward one action can't pass. AD-09 still says "move toward the goal" everywhere, so I routed that fix to the architecture.
3. **`dataviz` isn't installed,** so TC-15 can't check LOG-04's chart style.
4. **No regression case yet for FISH-11 and PREY-11.** Their oracle is a digest of a finished snake run, which only exists after the first snake build.

**Uncovered:** no pipeline lacks a golden case. FISH-11 and PREY-11 have no case yet (question 4).

Also still open from the last round: `docs/routes.md` has 4 lint errors. Its ticked history lines quote the names that their own changes retired.

Do you approve these expected outputs, including the default of 11 checkpoints? Once you do, I'll set the plan to Approved and offer to commit it. The two routed fixes would then come before `build-planning`: the TRAIN-03 count in the spec, and AD-09's corridor in the architecture.
